from requests.utils import get_netrc_auth

def test_valid_netrc():
    # Case 1: Standard user/pass
    netrc_content = "machine example.com login user password pass\n"
    netrc_path = "/tmp/.netrc_valid"
    with open(netrc_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(netrc_content)
    
    os.environ["NETRC"] = netrc_path
    try:
        auth = get_netrc_auth("http://example.com")
        print(f"Valid auth result: {auth!r}")
        assert auth == ("user", "pass"), f"Expected ('user', 'pass'), got {auth!r}"
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(netrc_path):
            os.remove(netrc_path)

    # Case 2: User but no password (or empty password)
    netrc_content = "machine example.com login user\n"
    netrc_path = "/tmp/.netrc_user_only"
    with open(netrc_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(netrc_content)
    
    os.environ["NETRC"] = netrc_path
    try:
        auth = get_netrc_auth("http://example.com")
        print(f"User only auth result: {auth!r}")
        # netrc.authenticators returns (login, account, password)
        # For "machine example.com login user", it should be ('user', '', '')
        # Our code does: login_i = 0 if _netrc[0] else 1 -> 0
        # return (_netrc[0], _netrc[2]) -> ('user', '')
        assert auth == ("user", ""), f"Expected ('user', ''), got {auth!r}"
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(netrc_path):
            os.remove(netrc_path)

    # Case 3: Account but no login
    netrc_content = "machine example.com : account_name password pass\n"
    netrc_path = "/tmp/.netrc_account_only"
    with open(netrc_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(netrc_content)
    
    os.environ["NETRC"] = netrc_path
    try:
        auth = get_netrc_auth("http://example.com")
        print(f"Account only auth result: {auth!r}")
        # _netrc = ('', 'account_name', 'pass')
        # login_i = 0 if _netrc[0] else 1 -> 1
        # return (_netrc[1], _netrc[2]) -> ('account_name', 'pass')
        assert auth == ("account_name", "pass"), f"Expected ('account_name', 'pass'), got {auth!r}"
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(netrc_path):
            os.remove(netrc_path)

    del os.environ["NETRC"]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_valid_netrc()
        print("All valid cases passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

def test_clear_meta_and_links_hash():
    s1 = Style(color="red", meta={"key": "val"})
    s2 = s1.clear_meta_and_links()
    
    # s1 and s2 should have different hashes because s1 has meta and s2 doesn't
    assert hash(s1) != hash(s2)
    
    # If we clear meta again from s1, it should be equal to s2
    s3 = s1.clear_meta_and_links()
    assert s2 == s3
    assert hash(s2) == hash(s3)

    # Test that changing meta affects hash
    s4 = Style(color="red", meta={"key": "val2"})
    s5 = s4.clear_meta_and_links()
    assert s2 == s5
    assert hash(s2) == hash(s5)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_clear_meta_and_links_hash()
    print("Test passed!")
